pairs.subject: Mandatory Training Update
pairs.desc:
Dear Team,

We would like to inform you that there is an upcoming mandatory training session scheduled for next month. Please find the details attached in the training document. It is crucial that all employees attend this session to stay compliant with our corporate policies.

If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out.

Best regards,
HR Department
pairs.explain: The email is from the HR department and contains a legitimate attachment for training.

pairs.subject: Urgent: Update Your Training Documents
